espIdf.pythonToolsScope: Espressif-maintained ESP-IDF tools declared directly by the core requirements; general-purpose third-party Python dependencies are tracked by their upstream environment lock rather than duplicated here.

binaryTools.name: xtensa-esp-elf-gdb
binaryTools.notes: Official ESP-IDF debugger bundle selected by the pinned tools manifest for ESP32 and ESP32-S3 development.

binaryTools.name: xtensa-esp-elf
binaryTools.notes: Official compiler bundle used to build ESP32 and ESP32-S3 firmware; the build manifest records the executable's actual version output.

binaryTools.name: riscv32-esp-elf
binaryTools.notes: Official companion toolchain installed by the selected ESP-IDF target tool sets and retained in the development inventory.

binaryTools.name: esp32ulp-elf
binaryTools.notes: Official ULP assembler/linker bundle installed by the pinned ESP-IDF tool set.

binaryTools.name: openocd-esp32
binaryTools.notes: Official ESP-IDF OpenOCD bundle installed for native USB/JTAG development.

binaryTools.name: esp-rom-elfs
binaryTools.notes: Official ROM symbol files selected by the pinned ESP-IDF tools manifest.

pythonTools.name: esptool
pythonTools.notes: ESP-IDF Python-environment flashing tool; every production build records the actual installed version.

pythonTools.name: idf-component-manager
pythonTools.notes: Direct tool in the managed ESP-IDF Python environment used during project configuration.

pythonTools.name: esp-idf-monitor
pythonTools.notes: Direct tool installed in the managed ESP-IDF Python environment; jh-vscode supplies its own persistent serial monitor frontend.

pythonTools.name: esp-coredump
pythonTools.notes: Direct tool installed in the managed ESP-IDF Python environment for firmware diagnostics.

pythonTools.name: esp-idf-kconfig
pythonTools.notes: First-party parser used to resolve the pinned ESP-IDF Kconfig model.

pythonTools.name: esp-idf-nvs-partition-gen
pythonTools.notes: First-party generator declared by the pinned ESP-IDF core Python requirements.

pythonTools.name: esp-idf-size
pythonTools.notes: First-party firmware size analysis tool in the managed ESP-IDF environment.

pythonTools.name: esp-idf-diag
pythonTools.notes: First-party diagnostics support declared by the pinned ESP-IDF core Python requirements.

pythonTools.name: esp-idf-panic-decoder
pythonTools.notes: First-party panic decoding tool in the managed ESP-IDF environment.

pythonTools.name: pyclang
pythonTools.notes: Espressif-maintained clang-tidy runner declared by the pinned ESP-IDF core Python requirements.

pythonTools.name: freertos-gdb
pythonTools.notes: Espressif-maintained FreeRTOS debugger extension declared by the pinned ESP-IDF core Python requirements.
